messages:
Anna M.: Heads up — since ~2026-03-20 06:12 UTC we've been seeing a small but steady spike of mTLS handshake failures for apac -> eu service calls. Noticing 502/524 variants from the proxy layer.
Raj P.: Any recent changes to KMS roles / keystore ACLs?
Anna M.: Yes, security trimmed a handful of IAM bindings yesterday as part of the RBAC sweep (removed a deprecated role from the proxy-service principal). I don't have the exact binding diff yet.
Mike L.: Can you paste the proxy logs (handshake errors) and the KMS deny logs if present?
Anna M.: Paste from proxy at 06:13 UTC:
```
2026-03-20T06:13:02Z proxy[ingress-eu] ERROR handshake failed: tls: certificate verify failed (remote error: tls: unknown certificate authority)
2026-03-20T06:13:02Z proxy[egress-apac->eu] WARN keystore: decrypt failed: access denied: kms:Decrypt denied for principal arn:service:proxy:apac:role/proxy-service
```

Raj P.: That looks like the proxy can't unwrap the leaf cert private key from the keystore because KMS decrypt was denied. Which role was removed exactly?
Sara T.: I cut the RBAC changes — I removed the legacy `kms-decrypter-legacy` binding after the audit. Looks like some proxies were still referencing that principal via older service-account annotations. I rolled back the binding for one region already.
DevOps-Bot: Alert: mtls-handshake-failures-apac generated 37 events in 15m — downstream errors: 502, 524.
Oncall L2: Linking INC-2026-0319 — https://incidents.company/INC-2026-0319 — triage started.
Raj P.: Quick triage plan: 1) Confirm which proxies still use legacy SA; 2) Rebind kms:Decrypt to proxy-service in apac as emergency rollback; 3) Restart cert-rotator in apac to rewrap keys; 4) Validate mTLS flows and certificate chain / OCSP.
Mike L.: To check rotator state run: `kubectl -n certs get deploy cert-rotator -o wide` — if the rotator can't call KMS it won't write new keystore bundles. Also check keystore contents: `kubectl -n certs exec -it keystore-0 -- ls -la /data/keys`
Anna M.: I ran those: rotator shows `CrashLoopBackOff` at 06:10 with logs `kms:Decrypt denied`. keystore pod still has last-rotated bundle timestamp 2026-03-19T22:00:10Z.
Raj P.: Can you paste the KMS audit entry for the denied decrypt?
Anna M.: KMS audit snippet:
```
2026-03-20T06:12:59Z KMS-AUDIT principal=arn:service:proxy:apac:role/proxy-service action=Decrypt resource=projects/redwood/keys/keystore keyring=regional-apac result=DENIED reason=MissingBinding: kms-decrypter-legacy
```

Sara T.: That's on me — the legacy binding removal cascade missed an SA annotation mapping. I will: re-add the binding as emergency, then schedule a clean mapping of all SA annotations to the new principal.
Oncall L2: While we do that, we should put an automatic fallback in routing policy to use eu-only routed instances for apac callers to avoid cross-region key usage (short term). Can infra do a 10m policy change? :eyes:
Mike L.: I can flip a canary routing rule in 10m. We should also verify OCSP stapling isn't the underlying cause: `openssl s_client -connect proxy.eu:443 -status` — but logs clearly show KMS denied so priority is RBAC rollback.
DevOps-Bot: Runbook pointer: /runbooks/keystore-kms-rbac-fallback — last updated 2026-02-14.
Raj P.: Post-rollback validation checklist: 1) Confirm `kms:Decrypt` success in audit logs for at least 3 keystore unwraps; 2) Ensure cert-rotator pod becomes `Running` and re-writes keystore bundle; 3) Confirm proxy handshakes succeed (smoketest) and 5xxs drop to normal baseline; 4) Create a short-lived alert to catch reoccurrence.
Anna M.: Rolling rebind now for apac region and restarting cert-rotator. I'll post logs.
(Six minutes later)
Anna M.: Rebind applied. KMS audit shows now: `result=ALLOWED principal=arn:service:proxy:apac:role/proxy-service action=Decrypt resource=...`
Anna M.: cert-rotator restarted, `kubectl -n certs get pods` shows `cert-rotator-0 Running`. Keystore bundle updated: `keystore-bundle-2026-03-20T06:20:05Z`
Mike L.: Smoketest from app -> proxy: TLS handshake ok, OCSP stapling present. No 502s in the last 5m.
Raj P.: We should still root-cause why SA annotation mapping pointed to legacy binding. Sara, can you add a postmortem note in the RBAC change PR and add an invariant check to CI that verifies all SA->principal mappings are in the new mapping table?
Sara T.: Yes. I'll open PR with: 1) revert-safe tag in change window, 2) a pre-change discovery script that lists active SA annotations and flags stale bindings, and 3) a short-term audit job (daily) to detect missing kms:Decrypt bindings for keystore principals.
Oncall L2: Incident declared resolved for now, monitoring 1h. Will escalate back to P1 if reoccurs.
Anna M.: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Sara to PR RBAC guardrails, Raj to add an alert rule for `keystore.decrypt.denied` > 3 in 5m, Mike to document routing fallback runbook step. :thumbsup:
DevOps-Bot: Action items recorded: [RBAC-ROLLBACK, KEYS-VALIDATE, ROTATOR-RESTART, ROUTE-FALLBACK].
Sara T.: I'll add timeline + screenshots to INC-2026-0319 and close postmortem loop once PR merges.
Mike L.: Leaving a note to review TLS config hardening next sprint — we should ensure we have explicit tests for keystore unwrap privileges as part of canary flows.
Anna M.: Good call. Closing thread for handoff, will update incident page.
